answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can influence a market, then slash that bond if its activity is proven to violate the rules. A Sybil attacker can still create many identities, but each one needs separately funded collateral and risks losing it, so multiplying votes or orders has a real capital cost. For example, an onyx-market agent might use an ember audit trail to link misconduct to a bonded account; a relic reputation alone should not substitute for the bond.
